Original reports omit argv/database/UUID operands, so successful distinct runs produce identical report bytes. This separate manifest preserves all original report hashes and independently distinguishes actual committed databases, exact invocation argv and physical root/scan/lineage/command/completion UUID operands. It adds provenance, not new test PASS or full H order certification.
